articles.summary: PITTSBURGH, Sept. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wesco International (NYSE:WCC), a leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions, is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work ® for the third year in a row.
articles.title: Wesco Earns 2026 Great Place To Work Certification™
